commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text:
Her friend comes as his go-between, and she says this for her friend to hear.

When it doesn’t have my lover my heart fears that, and when it has him it dwells on the parting to come and fears that. So its suffering never leaves. She is agreeing to the plea, thinking it unwise to have him and lose union. Not yet sated, she also fears he may leave again. There are only these two, so the suffering never ends.
